summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed from padded slices minus pad offsets; set_rnd skips "__" attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator wrapping iter_patch with copy-back off; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NumPy worker split, NotImplementedError on missing len, and per-patch apply_transform; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array (pinned single- and two-worker values), and test_missing_len. Caveats: test_loading_array calls set_determinism at its start while setUp also seeds, so seeding happens twice; the two-worker pinned values and the docstring example output are unverified because nothing was executed. Nothing committed.
